editorial.notes: The invocation that closes the prayers of Leo XIII, added to them by Pius X in 1904. Five words, and it is said three times — which this edition states in the reader's introduction rather than printing three identical pairs. Witness do prints all three; its transcription takes the first pair only and says so. COR at w001 is nominative in the function of address, as AGNUS is in the Agnus Dei: the form is a neuter one that would not show the difference anyway, and this edition marks the case the analyzers head. IESU at w002 is genitive — one of the four cases this Greek-Latin name spells alike, and the only one the sense allows here.
